en:
Captain... I did it again.
The ship has warped to a
planet in another
dimension.
Another mysterious black\nhole, right? Can't you do\nanything about them?

Well...they appear without
warning. Not even a
sophisticated AI like me
can avoid them.

What is going on? First
the room started shaking,
and now everything looks
different outside!
Ah, Celine!

I'm not sure how to
explain it, but...let's just
say we've accidentally
stumbled onto a planet
far, far away.

I'm sorry. I only just
summoned you onto this
ship, and now you're
already caught up in a
mess like this...

So wait... Is this an
unknown planet!? That's
music to the ears of any
treasure hunter!

Just think of all the
priceless riches waiting to
be discovered! Captain,
let's go look for them!
Celine, don't go out there\nby yourself! It's not safe!\nI'll come with you.

Just look at all this
natural beauty. ...Do you
think this is an uncharted
planet?

Maybe we'll stumble
across some ancient ruins
or a precious mineral
deposit!
Huh? I saw some people\nover there.
Some of the locals,\nperhaps? Let's go talk to\nthem.
I see we're not the first to\narrive.
What is it, Myuria?
Oh, hello there! Nice to\nmeet you! My name is\nSarah Jerand.

Sarah, I think this is the
place! The one we heard
all abou― Oh, are these
friends of yours?
No, no. I've never seen\nthem before, Reimi.
Hmm...? Do these people\nlook familiar, or am I\nimagining it?

Let me check their
vitals... No, these are
definitely unknown
individuals.
So it's "nice to meet you,"\nthen?
My name is Celine. What\nbrings you to a forest like\nthis?
Us? Well... We're looking\nfor a Phantom Axe Beak!
Axe Beak? Funny name\nfor a piece of treasure.
The Axe Beak is a type of\nlarge bird that lives here\non the planet Roak.

You can eat their meat
and eggs, and use other
parts of them for all sorts
of things.

Aww, rats. I was looking
for treasure, not some
bird. We have plenty of
those back in my kingdom.

It's not just any bird.
Phantom Axe Beaks are
the biggest, rarest birds
you'll ever see.

And more importantly,
their eggshells can be
used to make a
superluxurious skin lotion!
They're virtually priceless.
...A beautifying lotion?

Well, now I'm interested!
"Beauty" is a treasure that
women search for their
whole lives!

Right! That's why I was
showing everyone the
best place to look for
those eggs.
Beautiful skin? Sign me\nup!
Why bother? You're\nalready beautiful.
Wait... Sarah's going to lay\nan egg!?

Glad we're all on the same
page! I like when one
takes care of their
appearance.

Looks like this egg hunt
just got more
competitive... I wonder if
there will be enough eggs
for all of us?
...Wait. Did you just say I'm\nbeautiful?
I guess you're not as shy\nas you look!
...But you're still too\ninexperienced for me.

It takes a lot of effort to
look this good, hun. It
doesn't just happen by
magic. A wise person
notices these things.

What? Me!? I think you've
got the wrong end of the
stick! I'm not a bird, I'm
Featherfolk!
Now, now, Captain!\nComments like that will\nget you reported to HR!

Anyway, enough standing
around. I need to go find
one of those eggs. See
you around, little miss.
Hey, wait a second! That\ntreasure's mine!
Here we are. This looks\nlike the perfect spot for a\nnest.
Not bad, Sarah! I'm glad I\nasked a Featherfolk to\nlead the way.
Phantom Axe Beaks may\nbe huge, but they're\ngentle.
Bingo! There's a huge egg\nover there. Let's just take\nthe shell...
Eep!
Whoa! Looks like we've\nbeen rumbled!
Squawk!!!
It's coming right at us!
Didn't you say they were\n"gentle"? That thing's\npretty ferocious!

Forget the egg, we've got
a bigger problem now.
MUCH bigger! Can you
fight, little miss?
Of course. These symbols\naren't just for show,\ny'know!
Huff...huff... That seems to\nhave calmed it down...
Um... Sorry about this,\nbirdy.
But this is my ticket to\nbeautiful skin!
We did it, Myuria!
Ahem. My name is Celine!\nI'm not Myuria!

Oh! Haha! Sorry, sorry! No
offense, Celine. It's just
that both of you have the
exact same butt shape...

That one's Myuria, okay?
What exactly do you look
at when you try to tell
people apart?
My eyes are a little hazy,\nespecially in dimly lit\nplaces...
Oh! But I'm NOT a bird,\nokay!?

I guess they do look kind
of alike. For instance,
their...er, "minimal" dress
sense.
We look nothing alike!
Myuria, now that we're on\nthe subject...

What's with the skimpy
outfit, anyway? Trying to
attract a special
someone? It's a bold look,
I'll give you that.

Really? I've always
thought it is what
symbologists do. Show off
their symbols, you know?

And what about you, little
miss? Do many gentlemen
go for your... alternative
look?
H-hey! I'm...
I'm waiting for a prince...
Hehe... I knew it.
Wh-what!?

Your eyes really lit up
when you heard the egg
could be used to make a
beauty lotion.
Only women who are in\nlove care that much about\nbeing beautiful.
Isn't that right, Reimi?
What!? Why are you\nasking me!? I mean... I,\ner...guess so?
Sorry, I shouldn't tease. I\ngot a bit carried away.

But I have to
say...referring to the guy
you like as a "prince" is
pretty cute. I can tell
you're a romantic.
Th-that's not what I\nmeant...
No, I'm the one who said\ntoo much. Sorry, Miss\nMyuria.
No need to sound so\nformal, little miss. Um, I\nmean...Celine.
Well, that's a relief... I was\nafraid that might turn into\na big fight.
All right, time to pick up\nsome eggshells. That\nlotion won't make itself.

...Wait a second. That's
weird. This bird may be
huge, but it's just an
ordinary Axe Beak.
Say WHAT? How can an\nAxe Beak this big NOT be\na Phantom Axe Beak?
Oh wait, I just\nremembered something. I\nheard a strange rumor.

A lot of animals and
monsters are growing
bigger and going on
rampages these days.
Yikes, that sounds\nominous... What do you\nthink could be causing it?

...Now that you mention it,
there's this strange
substance on our
homeworld that's changing
everything.
We still don't know what it\nis, which is why we'd\nbetter be careful.

...Anyway, this is an
ordinary Axe Beak.
Unfortunately its eggs
have no effect on the
skin.
Aww, shoot. After all that\neffort...

But don't worry! Even
ordinary Axe Beaks make
a legendary substance
that's perfect for beauty
treatments!
Really? What is it!?
Their dung! So come on,\nlet's all grab a bucket,\nand―
Forget about it!!!
And so this part of the\nStar Ocean IV story\ncomes to a close.

We have a wide variety of
other tales planned for
the future. We hope you'll
look forward to them!
